name: ReSpawn
source:
After an... odd dream you wake up with a different life than you remember, then suddenly after going back to sleep, everything is back to normal... or so it seems.

[From [url=https://demon-hiro-games.itch.io/respawn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在做了一个……奇怪的梦之后，你醒来时的生活与你记忆中的不同，然后突然在重新入睡后，一切都恢复正常……或者看起来是这样。

[来自[url=https://demon-hiro-games.itch.io/respawn]Itch.io[/url]]
